title: Buying a Shirt
text:
Ana goes to the shop on Monday. She wants a blue shirt for school. The shirt costs ten dollars.

The shop has many colors. Ana tries on a green shirt, but it is too big. She buys the blue shirt and goes home happy.

questions.text: Why doesn't Ana buy the green shirt?
options: It is the wrong color for school
It is not in the shop

questions.text: How does Ana probably feel at the end of the story?
What can we guess about the shop?

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things
the different shades that things can be, such as red, blue or green

paragraph_translations: Ana va a la tienda el lunes. Quiere una camisa azul para la escuela. La camisa cuesta diez dólares.
La tienda tiene muchos colores. Ana se prueba una camisa verde, pero es muy grande. Compra la camisa azul y vuelve a casa feliz.
